component.name: Xmemos
component.summary: Privacy-first, 100% offline microblogging and knowledge-capture app

description.p: Xmemos is a privacy-first, 100% offline microblogging, journaling, and personal knowledge-capture desktop and mobile application featuring 1:1 SQLite database compatibility with Official FOSS Memos.
All data is stored locally in a WAL-mode SQLite database with full-text search (FTS5), rich Markdown/KaTeX rendering, atomic backup/restore, and zero telemetry or cloud dependencies.

ul.li: Resolved all strict Rust 1.100 Clippy -D warnings (OpenStickyWindowPayload DTO in commands/system.rs, removed redundant into_iter() in service/media.rs, and removed needless return in service/window_pin.rs)

Fixed Sticky Note navigation isolation: clicking Open on full map, #tags, or Open in Xmemos now routes cleanly to the main Xmemos window via system_focus_main_route + xmemos:navigate-main instead of hijacking the Sticky Note window, disabled global navigation hotkeys inside Sticky Notes, and added an inline expandable comments drawer inside Sticky Notes
Restored pinned tauri-build = "2.7.6" in src-tauri/Cargo.toml to match Cargo.lock cleanly
Removed unused std::process::Command import in src-tauri/src/service/window_pin.rs for zero-warning Rust builds under -D warnings

Fixed Sticky Note Always on Top on GNU/Linux Wayland (KDE Plasma 5/6 KWin via org.kde.KWin /Scripting D-Bus keepAbove + Hyprland via hyprctl pin) alongside native Windows HWND_TOPMOST, macOS NSFloatingWindowLevel, and Linux X11 _NET_WM_STATE_ABOVE

Fixed Sticky Note Always on Top toggle reverting immediately to disabled on GNU/Linux (X11/KDE/GNOME) caused by synchronous is_always_on_top() readback returning stale false before the async window manager state update completed

Prevented Desktop Sticky Note windows from snap-maximizing or quick-tiling to full screen when dragged against top/side screen edges on KDE Plasma (KWin), GNOME, and Windows via maximizable(false), max_inner_size(720, 860), drag-only header handling, and an automatic unmaximize safeguard

Upgraded Sticky Notes to render full rich memo media (AttachmentGrid images/videos/files + ImageLightbox), interactive Location mini-map previews (MemoLocationPreview + LocationPreviewPopover), linked memos, reactions, comment counts, visibility icons, and pin corner fold
Added dedicated cross-OS Always on Top toggle button backed by native Rust system_set_sticky_always_on_top with post-show WM sync across GNU/Linux, Windows 10/11, and macOS
Fixed memo_update payload bug (missing field id) when saving quick edits inside Sticky Note windows

Eliminated black startup flash on Desktop Sticky Note windows via native theme-matched background_color + double-rAF zero-flash reveal, and aligned Desktop/Android Sticky Note themes with Konsta UI macOS 2026 Liquid Glass & iOS Light/Dark aesthetics with 6 high-contrast palettes

Upgraded Android & Desktop Memo Shortcuts to interactive MS Sticky Notes style: resizable zero-polling Android Home-Screen AppWidgetProvider (XmemosMemoWidgetProvider) and lightweight RAM-capped floating Desktop Sticky Note windows (/sticky/:uid) with free drag/resize, color themes, Always-on-Top, interactive checkboxes, and inline quick edit
Fixed unused PathBuf import compiler warning in desktop_shortcut.rs on GNU/Linux

Added native Cross-OS Memo Shortcuts: pin any memo directly to the Android Home Screen (ShortcutManagerCompat adaptive Liquid Glass widget-style icon + dynamic long-press shortcuts) or to GNU/Linux (.desktop), Windows 10/11 (.lnk), and macOS (.app launcher) Desktops with cold/warm deep-link routing to /memo/:uid
Added re-type Confirm Password input with live length/mismatch validation and full en/id/es localization on Sign Up and Host Setup (/auth) to prevent accidental password typos

Redesigned PNG Export Share Card renderer (share-card.ts & share-card-markdown.ts) for 1:1 visual parity with in-app MemoCard across Light and Dark Liquid Glass themes, including rich Markdown formatting, attachments, location/relations metadata, reactions, and a minimal Xmemos emblem without "Offline Memos" text

Fixed 6-digit PIN form validation bug where Svelte interpolated pattern="[0-9]{6}" into "[0-9]6" causing false "Match the requested format" errors on Settings and PinLockOverlay, and hardened Android/IME soft-keyboard digit input

Redesigned canonical SVG application icon following Apple HIG macOS 2026 Liquid Glass standards and regenerated cross-OS icon assets (scalable SVG, PNGs, Windows ICO, macOS Retina ICNS, and Android Fastlane icon)
Replaced the SignIn/SignUp Shield icon and Desktop Sidebar badge with the unified Xmemos Liquid Glass AppIcon component

Refactored GitHub Actions release pipeline into modular reusable workflows (release.yml orchestrator + android-release.yml, linux-release.yml, windows-release.yml, macos-release.yml) with strict explicit secret isolation
Hardened 6-digit PIN local lock settings with Re-type confirmation input, strict numeric-only 6-digit validation, cold-start auto-lock, and Lock Now control
Added multi-platform offline desktop releases for GNU/Linux (AppImage & Flatpak), Windows 10/11 (Offline Installer & Portable), and macOS
Added native OS File Manager Save & Open dialogs for static memo file exports and database backups on Desktop
Added compile-time adaptive Android vs Desktop feature separation
